# GEO report: brightside-dental

**New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics.

## Code score: 73/100, Good

Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points).
How it's calculated: low = 18.25 ÷ 25 × 100 = 73. High = (18.25 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 73.

This is an Eleventy static site, so the content reaches crawlers as plain HTML. The points lost come from a wrong canonical origin, broken structured data, a missing `lang` and description, and `/services/` set to noindex. Every rule could be decided from the code, so nothing is unknown. All results are read from code.

## Live check

- **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL.

## Do these first

### 1. Point the canonical at the real domain
- **Why it matters:** A canonical tells search engines which address is the official one. Yours names a staging host on every page, which can send them to the wrong site.
- **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:8`
- **What the code says:** `<link rel="canonical" href="https://staging.brightside-dental.example{{ page.url }}">`
- **Size:** Small. Use `https://www.brightside-dental.example`, the origin in `geo.config.json` and `sitemap.xml`.
- **Score after this:** 80

### 2. Fix the invalid JSON-LD on the contact page
- **Why it matters:** JSON-LD is structured data that labels your business details for machines. A trailing comma makes it invalid JSON, so parsers will ignore it.
- **Where:** `src/contact.njk:10`
- **What the code says:** `"telephone": "0113 496 0000", }`
- **Size:** Small. Remove the comma. Adding `address` and `url` is optional (see Worth considering).
- **Score after this:** 75

### 3. Add `lang` to `<html>` and a description to the team page
- **Why it matters:** `lang` declares the page language. A missing description leaves search engines to guess at a snippet for `/team/`.
- **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:2`, `src/team.njk:1-4`
- **What the code says:** `<html>`, and the team front matter has only `title: Meet the team`
- **Size:** Small
- **Score after this:** 75

## Other problems found

None found. The `/services/` noindex is already counted under GEO-014. `thanks.njk` is noindex and not in the sitemap, which is consistent.

## Worth considering

- **Fix the `/services/` noindex:** `src/services.njk:5`: `noindex: true`. The page is in your nav and sitemap and describes what you sell. Removing the line would let it be found. If it's deliberately hidden, take it out of the nav and sitemap instead.
- **Enrich the Dentist JSON-LD:** `src/contact.njk:7`: `visit 12 Park Row, Leeds`. Add `address`, `url` and `openingHours` so the facts already on the page are labelled.
- **Back up the "thousands of patients" claim:** `src/index.njk:7`: `Trusted by thousands of local patients`. A real number or a patient review would support it.
- **Show your prices:** `src/services.njk:9`: `Our prices are simple and clear.` No prices appear anywhere, so listing them would back up the promise.
- **Name the dentists on the team page:** `src/team.njk:6`: `decades of experience`. Add names, qualifications and years.
- **Give each service its own page:** `src/services.njk:8` lists four items with no pages of their own, so each could get an address and a description.
- **Add `lastmod` to the sitemap:** `src/sitemap.xml:3` has no dates.
- **Check the hero image exists:** `src/index.njk:8` uses `/img/reception.jpg`, but no image file is in the repository.
- **Add social tags:** `base.njk` sets no `og:title` or `og:description`, which control link previews.
- **Link onward from the team and contact pages:** `src/team.njk` has no link to services or contact beyond the nav.

## Can't tell from code

- **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. If you have an access log, `geopilot logs <access log>` checks real crawlers against their published addresses.
- **Live-only checks:** real status codes, redirects and headers need a live scan.

## Assumptions

- You want search engines and AI search tools to find this site, which matches the `allow` policy in the config.
- `https://www.brightside-dental.example` is the intended origin.
- Only `/`, `/services/`, `/team/` and `/contact/` were checked. `/thanks/` is deliberately noindex.

## What to do next

1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written.
2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more.
3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL.

Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
